name: browser-automation
description: Real, governed browser automation built on Sidekick's Core browser subsystem: task-level tools for web evidence capture, rendered structured extraction and deterministic UI checks, plus runnable workflows for UI smoke verification, authenticated UI verification with governed credentials, and download verification. Every browser operation runs through the Core browser tool's egress policy, isolation, secret handling, artifact custody, approval and audit.

knowledge.title: Browser automation: scope, authorization and credentials
Browser automation: evidence and artifact expectations

default_allowed_hosts.description: Host ceiling applied to sessions opened by this pack's tools (*.example.com patterns supported). A per-call allowed_hosts may narrow it but never widen it. Narrows egress policy; never widens it. Secrets never belong in pack configuration.

allow_private_network.description: Default for whether this pack's tools may request private/loopback egress. Still requires the Core operator ceiling SIDEKICK_BROWSER_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK=true. Off by default.

network_scope.description: Optional exact operator-created named outbound network scope. Calls may narrow it with allowed_hosts but never select another scope.

full_page.description: Default for full-page screenshots in web_capture.

max_text_chars.description: Default bound on captured visible text in web_capture.
